charts.name: Liebherr 470 EC-B 20
charts.description: Flat-top tower crane with 83m max jib, 20 tonne max capacity. Features LM 1 and Load-Plus modes.

questions.question:
Determine the crane's gross capacity based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 83.0 m
• Operating mode — LM 1
• Radius — 40.0 m

options.explanation: Incorrect. 11.10 t is the LM 1 tip capacity of the 40.0 m jib, not the 83.0 m jib at 40.0 m radius. Use the 83.0 m row.
Correct. On the LM 1 table, 83.0 m jib at 40.0 m radius is 5.46 t (5,460 kg). Do not use the jib-tip graphic or the Load-Plus table.
Incorrect. 6.29 t is the Load-Plus capacity at 40.0 m on the 83.0 m jib. The question specifies LM 1.
Incorrect. 10.97 t is the LM 1 capacity of the 50.0 m jib at 40.0 m. Wrong jib-length row.

questions.src: Fulford LCR practical (8 load-chart + 2 rigging, 7/10) · SkilledTradesBC practical Part 1 · Level 1/2 E2 · RSOS C-8

questions.question:
Determine the crane's net capacity based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 83.0 m
• Operating mode — LM 1
• Radius — 40.0 m
• Hook block — 800 kg
• Rigging — 200 kg

options.explanation: Incorrect. That is the gross chart capacity. Net capacity = gross − hook block − rigging.
Incorrect. That only subtracts the hook block. Deduct rigging as well.
Correct. Gross on LM 1 at 40.0 m (83.0 m jib) is 5,460 kg. 5,460 − 800 − 200 = 4,460 kg.
Incorrect. That uses the Load-Plus gross (6,290 kg) minus 1,000 kg. Wrong table and wrong deduction.

questions.src: Fulford LCR practical (8 load-chart + 2 rigging, 7/10) · SkilledTradesBC practical Part 1 · Level 1/2 E2 · RSOS C-8

questions.question:
Determine the maximum radius the load can be placed based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 83.0 m
• Operating mode — LM 1
• Load weight — 8,000 kg
• Rigging — 200 kg

options.explanation: Incorrect. Gross load is 8,200 kg. At 29.4 m, LM 1 is only 8.04 t (8,040 kg). That would only work if you forgot the rigging.
Correct. Gross load = 8,000 + 200 = 8,200 kg. LM 1 83.0 m jib: 26.9 m = 8.96 t (sufficient). 29.4 m = 8.04 t (insufficient). Never interpolate. Maximum radius is 26.9 m.
Incorrect. 8.50 t at 50.0 m is the 50.0 m jib tip on the graphic, not the 83.0 m jib at 50.0 m (that is only 4.04 t).
Incorrect. At 31.9 m, LM 1 capacity is 7.27 t — well below 8,200 kg.

Incorrect. 4.04 t is the LM 1 capacity at 50.0 m on the 83.0 m jib. The question specifies Load-Plus.
Correct. Load-Plus, 83.0 m jib, 50.0 m radius is 4.70 t (4,700 kg). LM 1 at the same point is only 4.04 t.

Incorrect. 2.50 t is the LM 1 capacity of the 80.0 m jib at 80.0 m, not the 83.0 m tip.
Incorrect. 1.93 t is LM 1 at 80.0 m on the 83.0 m jib, not the tip.

options.explanation: Incorrect. 9.50 t − 8.50 t is the 50.0 m jib tip difference on the graphic, not the 83.0 m jib at 50.0 m.

questions.question: A 12,000 kg load (including rigging) must be placed between 35.0 m and 40.0 m. Using LM 1 and the 83.0 m jib, is this lift possible?

options.explanation: Incorrect. That answer uses the 35 m / 40 m jib-tip graphic (13.00 t / 11.10 t). On the 83.0 m jib those radii are 6.48 t and 5.46 t.
Incorrect. At 35.0 m the 83.0 m LM 1 capacity is 6.48 t — not 13.00 t.

options.text: No. On the 83.0 m jib, 12 t is only available inside 13.5 m
options.explanation: Correct. LM 1 83.0 m jib holds 20 t only from 2.6 m to 13.5 m. At 24.4 m it has already dropped to 10.07 t. 12,000 kg cannot be lifted at 35 m or 40 m.
Incorrect. Load-Plus at 35.0 m is 7.43 t — still well below 12 t.

questions.src: Fulford LCR practical (8 load-chart + 2 rigging, 7/10) · SkilledTradesBC practical Part 1 · Level 1/2 E2 · RSOS C-8

questions.question:
Determine the gross capacity based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 83.0 m
• Operating mode — LM 1
• Radius — 41.0 m (not listed on the chart)

options.explanation: Incorrect. That is the 40.0 m value. When radius is between listed values, do not interpolate and do not use the shorter radius.
Incorrect. Interpolation is never permitted. Go to the next longer listed radius (lower capacity).
Correct. 41.0 m is between 40.0 m (5.46 t) and 42.5 m (5.04 t). Use the next longer radius: 42.5 m = 5.04 t (5,040 kg).
Incorrect. 5.82 t is Load-Plus at 42.5 m. Wrong table.

questions.question:
Determine the difference in gross capacity between these two jib lengths:

• Radius — 40.0 m
• Jib length A — 50.0 m
• Jib length B — 83.0 m

options.explanation: Correct. 50.0 m jib at 40.0 m = 10.97 t. 83.0 m jib at 40.0 m = 5.46 t. Difference = 5.51 t = 5,510 kg. Same radius, longer jib, less capacity.
Incorrect. Same radius does not mean the same capacity. Jib length is a separate row.
Incorrect. That is the 40.0 m jib tip, not a difference.
Incorrect. That is not the table difference.

Correct. The chart states 'Lifting capacities valid up to 50 m hoisting height.' Above that, additional rope weight reduces capacity.

Incorrect. 100 m is used on some luffing charts (HC-LH), not this 470 EC-B chart.

questions.question:
Determine the crane's gross capacity based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 55.0 m
• Reeving — 2-fall
• Operating mode — LM 1

options.explanation: Incorrect. 3.89 t is 2-fall at 37.5 m, not 30.0 m. Also do not use the 1-fall column.
Correct. LM 1, 2-fall, 55.0 m jib: 8 t holds to 22.5 m, then 25.0 m = 7.03 t, 27.5 m = 6.22 t, 30.0 m = 5.51 t.
Incorrect. 6.00 t is the 1-fall (single-fall) capacity in the inner zone, not 2-fall at 30.0 m.
Incorrect. That value is not the 2-fall 55.0 m capacity at 30.0 m.

questions.src: Fulford LCR practical (8 load-chart + 2 rigging, 7/10) · SkilledTradesBC practical Part 1 · Level 1/2 E2 · RSOS C-8

questions.question:
Determine the crane's gross capacity based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 55.0 m
• Reeving — 1-fall (single fall)
• Operating mode — LM 1
• Radius — 25.0 m

options.explanation: Incorrect. 4.08 t is 1-fall at 40.0 m, not 25.0 m. 25.0 m is still inside the 6 t inner zone (3.0–30.9 m).
Incorrect. That mixes a 2-fall mid-range value with the 1-fall question.
Correct. 1-fall LM 1 on the 55.0 m jib is 6.00 t from 3.0 m to 30.9 m. 25.0 m is inside that zone.
Incorrect. 7.03 t is 2-fall at 25.0 m. The question specifies 1-fall.

questions.src: Fulford LCR practical (8 load-chart + 2 rigging, 7/10) · SkilledTradesBC practical Part 1 · Level 1/2 E2 · RSOS C-8

questions.question:
Determine the crane's gross capacity based on the following configuration:

options.explanation: Incorrect. 7.20 t is 2-fall at 27.5 m on the 45.0 m jib, not 25.0 m.
Incorrect. That is a 55.0 m jib 2-fall value at a different radius.
Incorrect. 12 t is only available in the inner zone (to 17.6 m) on this jib.

questions.src: Fulford LCR practical (8 load-chart + 2 rigging, 7/10) · SkilledTradesBC practical Part 1 · Level 1/2 E2 · RSOS C-8

questions.question:
Determine the maximum radius the load can be placed based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 55.0 m
• Reeving — 2-fall
• Operating mode — LM 1
• Load weight — 5,200 kg
• Rigging — 150 kg

options.explanation: Incorrect. Gross load is 5,350 kg. At 32.5 m, 2-fall is 4.90 t — too low.
Correct. Gross = 5,200 + 150 = 5,350 kg. 2-fall 55.0 m: 30.0 m = 5.51 t (sufficient). 32.5 m = 4.90 t (insufficient). Maximum radius is 30.0 m.
Incorrect. 3.89 t at 37.5 m is far below 5,350 kg. That radius is a common misread of the 3.89 t cell.
Incorrect. 22.5 m still has 8.00 t — the crane can reach further.

questions.src: Fulford LCR practical (8 load-chart + 2 rigging, 7/10) · SkilledTradesBC practical Part 1 · Level 1/2 E2 · RSOS C-8

questions.question:
Determine the difference in gross capacity between 1-fall and 2-fall based on the following configuration:

• Jib length — 55.0 m
• Operating mode — LM 1
• Radius — 25.0 m

options.explanation: Incorrect. That uses 4.08 t vs 4.90 t — those are the wrong radii on both tables.
Correct. At 25.0 m: 1-fall = 6.00 t (inner zone). 2-fall = 7.03 t. Difference = 1.03 t = 1,030 kg.
Incorrect. 2-fall does not double 1-fall at this radius. Structural limits apply.
Incorrect. Reeving changes the rated capacity. Read the matching table.

questions.question: With 2-fall reeving, which jib can lift 12 t at minimum radius?

options.explanation: Incorrect. The 55.0 m jib 2-fall maximum is 8 t.
Correct. 2-fall reaches 12 t on the 40 m and 45.0 m jibs (inner zone). 50.0 m jib max is 10 t; 55.0 m jib max is 8 t.
Incorrect. Longer jibs start at a lower maximum even at minimum radius.
Incorrect. The 50.0 m jib 2-fall maximum is 10 t.

Incorrect. The stated limit is 100 m.

options.text: Yes — 5.8 USt is greater than 7 tonnes

Incorrect. That radius still has much more capacity than required.
